title: Hoel macro variables give ambiguous interventions

statements.text: The macro variables implied by Hoel’s 2017 account yield interventions with significant ambiguity, and marginalization and abstraction do not commute, problems traced to averaging steps and a maximum-entropy distribution extraneous to the system.

sources.quote: We provide a critical assessment of the account of causal emergence presented in Erik Hoel's 2017 article
